h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Durgapur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Durgapur

items.pText: Durgapur was planned as a steel and industrial city, and many of its township parks and school grounds were laid out decades ago. If your site still has old painted steel swings and slides, replacing them is a chance to plan the whole area again. FunPlay Systems supplies new playground equipment to Durgapur from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,560 km away, delivered by road.

Older parks often have pieces placed close together, with little room between a swing and the nearest path. We redraw the area with a proper safe play area around each piece and suggest what to keep, move or remove. Our in-house team designs and builds everything, from roto-moulded slides to galvanised frames. A dealer in eastern India or our own team then installs the new equipment.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Replacing old play equipment in a township park

c: Start with a walk around the existing area. Note which pieces are rusted at the base, which have broken seats or chains, and where the ground has worn into hollows under the swings. Clear those pieces before the new ones arrive and check that nothing sharp is left in the ground, since old foundations are rarely in the right place for a new layout. Durgapur's monsoon is heavy, so fill and level the worn ground and lay rubber flooring before installation.

items.q: Can new equipment use our old foundations?
items.a: Usually not, because the new layout and post positions are different. We plan fresh foundations, self-standing or grouted, based on the ground at your site. Old post holes should be filled and levelled first.

items.q: Do you supply parks and schools in Durgapur?
items.a: Yes. Parks, schools, housing societies and industrial townships in Durgapur can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a local dealer.

items.q: How do we start a replacement project?
items.a: Send us photos of the current play area, its measurements and the age group of the children. We will suggest new equipment and a layout with the safe play area marked.
